description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Squall (Fire)], [Apex Draw & Junction Damage Tracker] and [Apex Draw & Junction Level]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Squall (Fire)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Draw & Junction (0~2), removed after using Apex Draw & Junction two times

description.name: Apex Draw & Junction Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Draw & Junction level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Squall (Fire)]

description.name: Apex Draw & Junction Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Draw & Junction level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Squall (Fire)]
